product_overview: phoneX is a D2C storefront for precision-cut vinyl skins for phones, tablets, and laptops. Customers can browse designs, find exact device-compatible skins, customize their own artwork, and complete purchases through cart and checkout flows, while admins manage the catalogue and operations through a protected panel.
core_goals: Browse skin collections and device-compatible products
Find products by device type, brand, model, or search
Customize and save a bespoke skin design
Add products to cart and complete checkout
Review past orders and saved wishlist items
Manage products, devices, categories, orders, users, coupons, and reviews in the admin panel

features.name: Customer sign in with email and password
features.description: Returning customers can sign in with their email and password to access their account and continue shopping.
user_flows: /login -> Fill the email address -> Fill the password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the account page
/login -> Submit the sign-in form with empty or malformed input -> See inline validation messages
/login -> Fill incorrect credentials -> Submit the sign-in form -> See an error toast

features.name: Customer registration
features.description: New customers can create an account using their name, email, and password.
user_flows: /signup -> Fill name, email, password, and password confirmation -> Submit the registration form -> See the account page with a success toast
/signup -> Fill a weak password or mismatched confirmation -> See inline validation messages

features.name: Password reset request
features.description: Customers can request a password reset link by email.
user_flows: /forgot-password -> Enter a registered email address -> Submit the reset request -> See a confirmation message

features.name: Browse and filter the shop
features.description: Shoppers can explore the full skin catalogue, refine results with filters, sort them, and move through pages of results.
user_flows: /shop -> Open the filters panel -> Select one or more categories, materials, or finishes -> Set price or rating limits -> Choose a sort order -> See the updated product grid
/shop -> Open the filters panel -> Clear all filters -> See the unfiltered product grid
/shop -> Move to the next page of results -> See a new page of products
/shop -> Open a product from the grid -> See the product detail page

features.name: Search products and collections
features.description: Users can search for products, collections, brands, or device-related results from the search page.
user_flows: /search -> Enter a product or collection name -> Submit the search -> See matching results
/search -> Enter a query with no matches -> Submit the search -> See an empty state

features.name: Browse devices by type and brand
features.description: Users can explore devices by category and narrow collections by brand before opening a compatible collection or model.
user_flows: /devices/phones -> Browse phone device cards -> Select a brand filter -> See the list narrow to that brand -> Open a collection or model
/devices/tablets -> Browse tablet device cards -> Select a brand filter -> See the list narrow to that brand -> Open a collection or model
/devices/laptops -> Browse laptop device cards -> Select a brand filter -> See the list narrow to that brand -> Open a collection or model

features.name: Device model page
features.description: Users can view skins compatible with a specific device model, choose variant options, and add an item to the cart.
user_flows: /devices/phones -> Open a brand page -> Open a specific model page -> See skins that fit the exact device -> Choose a material or finish variant -> Add the item to cart -> See a confirmation toast
/devices/tablets -> Open a brand page -> Open a specific model page -> See skins that fit the exact device -> Choose a material or finish variant -> Add the item to cart -> See a confirmation toast
/devices/laptops -> Open a brand page -> Open a specific model page -> See skins that fit the exact device -> Choose a material or finish variant -> Add the item to cart -> See a confirmation toast

features.name: Browse design collections
features.description: Users can browse all public skin collections and open a collection to see its products.
user_flows: /designs -> See all collection cards -> Open a collection -> See the products inside it

features.name: Product detail and add to cart
features.description: Users can review a product, adjust quantity, and add it to the cart.
user_flows: /products/abstract -> Change the quantity -> Add the product to cart -> See the cart count increase
/shop -> Open a product card -> Review the product detail page -> Choose quantity -> Add the product to cart -> See a confirmation toast

features.name: Cart management
features.description: Authenticated users can review the cart, change quantities, and remove items before checkout.
user_flows: /cart -> Increase an item quantity -> Decrease an item quantity -> See the subtotal update
/cart -> Remove an item -> See the cart update
/cart -> Remove all items -> See the empty cart state

features.name: Checkout
features.description: Authenticated customers can enter a shipping address, apply a coupon, and proceed to payment creation.
user_flows: /checkout -> Fill full name, phone, address, city, state, and PIN code -> Submit the address form -> Apply a coupon code -> Click pay -> See the payment step
/checkout -> Submit an incomplete address -> See validation errors

features.name: Orders
features.description: Authenticated customers can view their order history and inspect the details of a specific order.
user_flows: /orders -> See the list of past orders -> Open an order -> See items, shipping address, payment status, and status timeline
/orders -> See the empty state for a new account

features.name: Wishlist
features.description: Authenticated users can save products for later and manage saved items.
user_flows: /wishlist -> Save a product from a product card -> Open the wishlist page -> See the saved product
/wishlist -> Remove a saved product -> See the empty state

features.name: Custom studio
features.description: Users can start a custom skin design, choose a device category, add artwork, pick a finish, save the design, or add it to cart.
user_flows: /customize -> Choose a device category -> Open the studio for that type -> Select a device model -> Upload or choose artwork -> Pick a finish -> Save the design -> See it in saved designs
/customize -> Choose a device category -> Open the studio for that type -> Select a device model -> Upload or choose artwork -> Pick a finish -> Add the custom design to cart -> See the cart update

features.name: Newsletter subscription
features.description: Users can subscribe to the newsletter from the footer by entering an email address.
user_flows: / -> Scroll to the footer -> Enter an email address -> Subscribe -> See a confirmation message

features.name: Admin sign in and catalogue management
features.description: Admin users can sign in and manage products, devices, brands, categories, inventory, orders, users, reviews, coupons, analytics, and storefront design.
user_flows: /admin/login -> Fill admin email and password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the admin dashboard
/admin/login -> Fill customer credentials -> Submit the sign-in form -> See an access denied toast
/admin/products -> Open the products page -> Create a product -> Edit product details -> See the updated product in the list
/admin/devices -> Open the devices page -> Create or edit a model -> Upload an optional photo -> See the updated model in the list
/admin/categories -> Open the categories page -> Create, edit, or delete a category -> See the catalogue update
/admin/inventory -> Open the inventory page -> Edit stock for a variant -> See the updated stock value
/admin/orders -> Open the orders page -> Update an order status -> See the updated status
/admin/users -> Open the users page -> Activate or deactivate a user -> See the updated user status
/admin/reviews -> Open the reviews page -> Approve or reject a pending review -> See the review removed from the queue
/admin/coupons -> Open the coupons page -> Create a coupon -> See it appear in the list
/admin/analytics -> Open the analytics page -> Review sales and customer charts -> See the dashboard metrics
/admin/design -> Open the design settings page -> Review storefront design tokens -> See the live design controls

routes.description: Storefront home with hero, category strip, featured designs and offers.
All skins with server-side filters (category, material, finish, price, rating, stock), sort and pagination.
Search results for a text query.
Browse every skin collection (public, no sign-in required).
Device catalogue index grouped by type.
Device type or brand page showing compatible skin collections with a brand filter.
Model page listing skins that fit that exact device, with variant/material options and add to cart.
Product detail page with media, price, variants, quantity and add to cart.
Design a custom skin for a device type (phone-skin, laptop-skin, photo-case, metal-case).
Email and password sign in, plus Google sign-in.
Create a customer account with email and password, plus Google sign-up.
Cart with quantity controls, removal and order summary.
Admin device model management with optional photo upload.

known_limitations.issue: Google sign-in is rendered inside a cross-origin Google iframe and Google blocks automated sign-in, so the full flow cannot be completed by an automated test
known_limitations.impact: Only the presence of the Continue with Google button can be asserted

known_limitations.issue: Checkout opens the external Razorpay payment sheet
known_limitations.impact: An order cannot be paid end to end in an automated test; stop at order creation

known_limitations.issue: Admin routes need an ADMIN or MANAGER account; customer signup only creates CUSTOMER accounts
known_limitations.impact: Admin flows cannot be tested with the frontend test account

known_limitations.issue: Catalogue data is served by the live API at https://phonexbe.innocollab.in/api/v1
known_limitations.impact: Tests depend on network access and on that API being up; product and collection names change with live data

known_limitations.issue: Cart and wishlist are persisted per user and synced with the server, so test runs share state with the test account
known_limitations.impact: Tests should empty the cart first for repeatable results
